metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Life is full of hardships, struggles, and challenges that one must face.
acceptable_visual_variants: A traveler walking on a cracked, dry path under a blazing sun
A silhouette of a person walking against a bright, blinding light on an empty road
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: There will be hot sunshine on the physical journey
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing a literal sunny road might look pleasant and warm rather than representing harsh, exhausting struggles.

metaphor_mapping.vehicle_concept: A difficult journey under a hot sun

metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: There will be sunshine on the journey
metaphor_spans.tenor: The struggles and hardships of life
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a lone traveler walking on a dusty, dry road under a harsh, glaring sun, emphasizing exhaustion and heat.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The competitive, chaotic, and conformist society of people.
acceptable_visual_variants: A sea of blurred, identical figures moving together
A dense crowd of people on a city street, shot from a high angle to emphasize loss of individuality
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: A literal crowd might look like a festive gathering rather than a symbol of societal pressure and conformity.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: The mass of humanity conforming to societal pressures
metaphor_mapping.vehicle_concept: A dense crowd of people moving together

metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a dense, faceless crowd of people moving in one direction, with one figure attempting to step out or move differently.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'dhoop' as 'sunshine' loses the negative, harsh connotation of scorching heat/hardship that 'dhoop' carries in this context, making it sound pleasant rather than challenging.
The translation of 'nikal sko' as 'move on' loses the specific nuance of emerging, breaking out, or extricating oneself from a dense crowd ('bheed').

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Opportunities, assistance, or a clear path to success in life.
acceptable_visual_variants: A narrow alleyway blocked by indifferent figures
A maze where others block the exits and pathways
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing a literal road block might look like a traffic scene rather than social selfishness.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: People helping or hindering one's progress in society
metaphor_mapping.vehicle_concept: A physical path being blocked or cleared by others

metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a narrow path where figures stand shoulder-to-shoulder, blocking passage for anyone else.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation 'stand up after I fall' misses the active, causal nuance of 'mujhe gira ke' (by knocking me down / pushing me down) and the specific meaning of 'sambhal sako' (steadying yourself / recovering balance).

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The course of life, destiny, or external circumstances.
acceptable_visual_variants: A straight, unyielding highway cutting through a harsh landscape
A stone-paved road that remains fixed and unchanging
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal roads shifting or bending might look like a fantasy scene rather than a metaphor for the rigidity of life.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: The world adapting to an individual's desires
metaphor_mapping.vehicle_concept: A road changing its direction for a traveler

metaphor_spans.tenor: The course of life and external circumstances
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a rigid, unbending stone path stretching into the distance, indifferent to the traveler standing on it.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The rhetorical force of 'kahan badalti hain' (where do they ever change?) is flattened into a simple negative statement 'do not change'.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The fleeting, superficial hopes, dreams, and illusions that keep humans occupied and comforted in life.
acceptable_visual_variants: An adult cradling fragile, glowing origami shapes or simple wooden playthings
Delicate, glowing bubbles shaped like toys floating around a pensive figure
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Playthings or toys meant for children
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal children's toys might make the scene look childish or literal, missing the existential weight of life's illusions.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: Illusions and hopes that keep adults going in a difficult world
metaphor_mapping.vehicle_concept: Toys used to distract and amuse a child

metaphor_spans.tenor: Fleeting dreams and hopes that distract humans from the harsh reality of life
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show an adult figure holding fragile, glowing, abstract shapes (representing dreams/hopes) like delicate glass toys in a dark, vast space.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'bahal sako' as 'find comfort' slightly softens the nuance of 'behlana', which implies amusing, distracting, or pacifying oneself (as a child with toys).

annotation.theme: The harsh, competitive reality of life's journey and the necessity of self-reliance and finding contentment in small hopes.

original_poem:
सफ़र में धूप तो होगी, जो चल सको तो चलो,
सभी हैं भीड़ में, तुम भी निकल सको तो चलो।

यहाँ किसी को कोई रास्ता नहीं देता,
मुझे गिरा के अगर तुम सँभल सको तो चलो।

किसी के वास्ते राहें कहाँ बदलती हैं,
तुम अपने आप को खुद ही बदल सको तो चलो।

यही है ज़िन्दगी, कुछ ख़्वाब, चंद उम्मीदें,
इन्हीं खिलौनों से तुम भी बहल सको तो चलो।
translated_poem:
There will be sunshine on the journey, walk if you can,
Everyone is in the crowd, if you can move on, walk along.

No one here offers a way to anyone else,
If you can stand up after I fall, walk along.

Paths do not change for anyone here,
If you can change yourself, walk along.

This is life: a few dreams, a handful of hopes,
If you can find comfort in these toys, walk along.
